actors.retained_burden: Own the definition of the work before an instrument is selected.
Own the architecture and burden of the selection transaction.
Own the claim that a score or report has a defined interpretation.
Own the final weighting and cannot hide judgment behind HR or vendor output.
Learn from both observed outcomes and outcomes made unobservable by the policy.
Participate in the record rather than serving only as raw assessment material.
Test discrimination risk, construct drift, and institutional monoculture.

controls.name: role_object_custody
controls.requirement: Preserve actual work, conditions, success criteria, and failure criteria before selecting an instrument.

controls.name: instrument_and_threshold_custody
controls.requirement: Preserve vendor, instrument, version, norm group, constructs, sequence, time burden, threshold, and override rule.

controls.name: pretest_accommodation_disposition
controls.requirement: Record the disposition of an accommodation request before testing and distinguish the intended construct from an irrelevant limitation.

controls.name: signal_conflict_custody
controls.requirement: When interviews, work samples, and scores conflict, preserve which evidence prevailed, who decided, and why.

controls.name: candidate_evidence_return
controls.requirement: Return an intelligible report, correction path, and bounded appeal; substantial applicant labor should return compensation or useful evidence.

controls.name: exploration_budget
controls.requirement: Advance a pre-registered bounded sample of uncertain or near-threshold candidates to richer review so some false negatives become observable.

controls.name: prediction_reconciliation_and_monoculture_audit
controls.requirement: Reconcile later evidence against the original prediction and audit shared-vendor concentration, drift, repeated rejection, and model revision.

design: pre-register eligibility and sampling rules before outcomes are known
sample a bounded set of near-threshold, uncertain, or distributionally novel candidates
use a job-relevant simulation or richer structured review rather than automatic hiring
record accommodations, time burden, evidence conflicts, and overrides
compare subsequent outcomes against the original prediction with privacy, consent, and retention limits
revise role model, instrument, threshold, or weighting when repeated errors are supported

non_entitlements: Later success does not prove the employer was obligated to hire the candidate for the original vacancy.
A rejection, missing explanation, or accommodation question does not by itself establish illegality or discrimination.
A test score does not explain the role model, threshold, accommodation handling, or evidence weighting that produced an adverse decision.
Validation among selected employees does not identify false negatives without exploration, external outcomes, or additional assumptions.
